run_image_classification_training: run a transformers model fine-tuned for image classification on Habana Gaudi accelerators using GaudiTrainer
run_image_classification_evaluation: run evaluation of a fine-tuned image classification model on a validation dataset with accuracy metrics
create_data_training_arguments: create a DataTrainingArguments dataclass to configure dataset name, train and validation directories, and train-val split ratio
create_model_arguments: create a ModelArguments dataclass to configure the pretrained model path, config, revision, and token for image classification
create_gaudi_trainer: create a GaudiTrainer instance with a model, GaudiConfig, training arguments, datasets, and a data collator function
